title: Satisfiability of Equality Equations
description: Determine if a system of equality and inequality equations is satisfiable using Union-Find.
pseudocode:
1. parent = Array(26).fill(0).map((_, i) => i)
2. find = (i) => parent[i] === i ? i : (parent[i] = find(parent[i]))
3. for (eq of equations) if (eq[1] === '=') parent[find(eq.charCodeAt(0)-97)] = find(eq.charCodeAt(3)-97)
4. for (eq of equations) if (eq[1] === '!' && find(eq.charCodeAt(0)-97) === find(eq.charCodeAt(3)-97)) return false
5. return true

steps.note: Initialize parent array where each letter points to itself (a=0, b=1, c=2)
Process 'a==b': Union 'a' and 'b'. Parent of 0 becomes 1.
Process 'a!=b': Find(a) is 1, Find(b) is 1. Since 1 == 1, return false.
